subtitles.en: MS is great to have you here, especially on such a really milestone day for CMT.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴您能来，尤其是在CMT这个里程碑式的日子。

subtitles.en: I mean, 400% gains in north of that. How do you feel like this is going to look like for the rest of the week, and maybe in the perceived future months here now?
subtitles.zh: 涨幅超过400%。您认为本周乃至未来几个月市场会如何表现？

subtitles.en: Hi, good morning, thanks for having me. It's an incredible moment that only 10-year-old baby in memory semi-conductor manufacturing industry is getting listed.
subtitles.zh: 早上好，感谢邀请。这是一个不可思议的时刻，一家仅成立十年的存储半导体制造企业成功上市。

subtitles.en: And initial trading price, 446% upside, that's incredible.
subtitles.zh: 开盘价上涨446%，太惊人了。

subtitles.en: This company has been catching up the peer groups, but I believe that these share excitement is reflecting the upside potential.
subtitles.zh: 这家公司一直在追赶同行，我认为股价的兴奋反映了其上涨潜力。

subtitles.en: Because we need to understand the meaning of the market, CMT is a DRAM company. And it's supporting the local supply chains initially.
subtitles.zh: 我们需要理解市场的意义，CMT是一家DRAM公司，最初它支持本土供应链。

subtitles.en: And the local supply chain, the China market itself, it has been open to everyone.
subtitles.zh: 本土供应链和中国市场本身一直对所有人开放。

subtitles.en: Because the CMT was not capable of delivering what they need, but it's catching up.
subtitles.zh: 因为CMT此前无法满足需求，但它正在追赶。

subtitles.en: And as David mentioned, that it's moving to HBM and more sophisticated devices as well.
subtitles.zh: 正如David提到的，它正向HBM和更复杂的器件迈进。

subtitles.en: So if CMT is capable of delivering what they need, then the meaning of the market is going to be a lot different than before. So that is the real value of this company's growth potential in terms of market care.
subtitles.zh: 如果CMT能够满足需求，那么市场的意义将大不相同。这就是该公司在市场份额方面增长潜力的真正价值。

subtitles.en: But so far, the company has been growing much better than expected.

subtitles.en: I mean, David here, by the way, as things stand, it's already the biggest, the most valuable company in mainland China.
subtitles.zh: David，顺便说一句，目前它已经是中国内地最大、市值最高的公司。

subtitles.en: At your point, it's not been around for very long, and it's in an industry where the moat and barriers to enter are almost impossibly high to enter, yet here we are.

subtitles.en: Well, I think the China's story of AI packs has just started yet because if you look at
subtitles.zh: 我认为中国的AI算力故事才刚刚开始，因为如果你看看

subtitles.en: those big internet platform companies, their free cash flow is actually even healthier than the US peers.
subtitles.zh: 那些大型互联网平台公司，它们的自由现金流实际上比美国同行更健康。

subtitles.en: So that means, you know, and not mention the total amount that those leading companies, those internet platform companies, investing in AI packs is even, is still a lower than the US.
subtitles.zh: 这意味着，更不用说那些领先的互联网平台公司在AI算力上的投入总额，仍然低于美国。

subtitles.en: So that means the China still needs to invest heavily.
subtitles.zh: 所以中国仍需大力投入。

subtitles.en: And always, you know, we keep telling our clients that there are two baskets in China, Asia.
subtitles.zh: 而且我们一直告诉客户，在亚洲中国有两个篮子。

subtitles.en: China is the US supply chain with names center in the telecom equipment because they are the providers to the media.
subtitles.zh: 中国是美国供应链中电信设备领域的核心，因为它们是媒体的供应商。

subtitles.en: And another one is within the domestic semis. So I think this latest cycle catch-up story will work, but it's happening right now.
subtitles.zh: 另一个是国内半导体。所以我认为这一轮追赶周期会奏效，而且正在发生。

subtitles.en: And not mention that Changshin, it has made 100 billion in the first half.
subtitles.zh: 更不用说中芯国际，上半年盈利1000亿。

subtitles.en: So, sorry, 50 billion in the first, 56 billion in the first half.
subtitles.zh: 抱歉，是上半年560亿。

subtitles.en: So for this year, the earnings should be around 100 billion or even higher.
subtitles.zh: 所以今年盈利应该在1000亿左右甚至更高。

subtitles.en: So with that amount of cash at hand, I won't be surprised if it started investing domestic equipment as well.
subtitles.zh: 手握如此现金，它开始投入国产设备我也不会惊讶。

subtitles.en: So the whole domestic supply chain would be the beneficiary of this new trend.
subtitles.zh: 整个国内供应链将成为这一新趋势的受益者。

subtitles.en: And not mention their evaluation has been quite attractive at this moment.
subtitles.zh: 而且目前它们的估值相当有吸引力。

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
